name: How much does it cost to install garage flooring in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install garage flooring in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of garage flooring installation in the Bay Area varies significantly based on the material chosen, the size of the garage, and the condition of the existing concrete. Epoxy and polyaspartic coatings typically range from $3 to $9 per square foot, including labor and materials. Interlocking tiles can be $2 to $5 per square foot, plus installation if not DIY. Factors like concrete repair, custom finishes, or multiple coats can influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage flooring installation costs in the Bay Area typically range from $2 to $9 per square foot, depending on materials, garage size, and concrete condition.
